record_type: Selected public result excerpts and editorial summary from preserved first-party test records
provenance_note: Auxtho conducted these tests in its own test environments. The selected rows preserve expected and recorded actual status codes and verdicts from original records. Plain-language case labels replace internal identifiers; identities, endpoints and request details are omitted. These are first-party test records, not independent security certification.

implementation_control_tests.assertion_scope: These are selected descriptions of test assertions and recorded implementation checkpoints, not new production observations. Preserved test code evolved beyond its earliest run; no claim is made that today's source is byte-identical to every historical test run. No matched attack-learning rate is established.

local_workflows.environment: Controlled local workflows with seeded test data
local_workflows.replay_validation_scope: Integrity and binding of the result to the recorded request/execution; not verification of every AI-generated document or finding
observations: Invalid results were excluded from accepted replay evidence; results and reasons remained available for investigation.

The verified isolated-shadow baseline replay remained accepted after eight invalid results were excluded. Verified replay evidence does not itself resolve an incident or complete every reactivation condition.

A request and review by a distinct authorized reviewer were required to resume shadow evaluation. The requester could neither review nor apply that reactivation; applying it required the approved reviewer. Production rules were not changed.
Containment did not itself close the incident.

own_live_backend_suites.count_note: Normal reads and invalid requests are included. These are not counts of attacks prevented.

earlier_pressure_history.changed_condition: Test-client timeout budget adjusted before the separate rerun
earlier_pressure_history.interpretation: This records an earlier failed test and a changed-condition rerun. It does not establish that a backend defect was fixed or combine these requests with the extended suite into an attack or learning count.
